deepdive.divline: - Post-IPO balance sheet strong: net worth Rs 844.8 cr, D/E 0.3x

profile.entities: NTPC / NTPC REL (key customer — Solapur, Unchahar BESS; Bikaner 260 MW solar BOS; 600 MW module supply); SJVN (claims dispute); MUFG Intime (call host)
profile.mgmt: Kartik Teltia (MD); Mukut Goyal (CFO); Varsha Bharti (CS & Compliance)
profile.subseg: Utility-scale solar EPC (PSU-led); BESS EPC + IPP; solar module manufacturing (1.5 GW, Roorkee); solar cell mfg (1.2 GW, under construction); BESS container mfg (3.4 GW); O&M (3-yr, not actively pursued)
profile.themes: Renewables / Solar capex + BESS (battery storage) build-out — directly exposed

bull_bear.body:
- Post-IPO balance sheet strong: net worth Rs 844.8 cr, D/E 0.3x.
- ~Rs 430 cr earmarked for battery/solar **cell** line — still largely unspent (timing-driven, not abandoned); to deploy as construction/equipment ordering begins (~Q3 FY27).
- Focus: capital efficiency, cash-flow generation, capacity addition.
bull_bear.title: Capital Allocation (IPO proceeds)

bull_bear.body:
- **Execution:** solar EPC exposed to land-acquisition/handover delays (BESS less so — small land, near substation). ~14-month EPC window.
- **Raw-material / FX:** metals inflation + INR depreciation pressuring margins; war-dependent.
- **Working capital / receivables:** SJVN dispute (Rs 219 cr claimed vs Rs 52 cr booked); access to working capital is a stated bidding prerequisite.
- **Client concentration:** heavily PSU/NTPC-dependent (reverse bidding); mgmt working to broaden PSU + private base.
- **PPA cancellations / rescissions:** PSUs/DISCOMs not signing PPAs after L1 — industry-wide issue (grid connectivity lag; ~10–12 months to resolve).
- **ALMM/ALCM2 cell shortage:** 6–12 month DCR cell shortage risk industry-wide (current order book has no ALCM2 orders → ~1-yr headway; own cell line online June-27).
- Module-line under-utilisation if EPC orders lag.
bull_bear.title: Risks

bull_bear.body: Confident, candid, granular. Owns the missed Rs 1,500 cr / 11% PAT guide and blames war/late ALMM rather than deflecting. Realistic on FY27 (won't repeat 200–250% growth; guides ~40–45%). Refuses to over-promise on order inflow / industry demand it doesn't operate in (KUSUM, rooftop). Bullish structurally on BESS + backward integration.
bull_bear.title: Management Tone

bull_bear.body:
- Captive module output is **eliminated on consolidation** — boosts margin, not reported top line (investors may mis-model module "revenue").
- BESS lithium **cells sourced from China** (no India supplier) → FX + import dependency on the higher-margin segment.
- Mgmt views long-term O&M as value-destructive (manpower-heavy, low rev) — contrarian vs typical "annuity O&M" investor framing.
- DCR cell shortage is a **net positive** for SOLARWORLD relative to peers (no ALCM2 orders yet + own cell line coming) → competitive moat as forced industry shift hits unintegrated EPCs.
- ROW compensation now on **market rate** (vs stale circle rate) — easing transmission-line land friction industry-wide.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious Insights

business.body:
- **Solar EPC** = core, highest margin; PSU/NTPC-driven; reverse-bidding.
- **O&M deliberately NOT pursued** — contracts only 3 yrs post-install; on a 100 MW project EPC rev ~Rs 250–300 cr vs O&M rev only ~Rs 7–8 cr over 3 yrs with near-same manpower. After 3 yrs O&M re-tendered to specialists (5–7 yr). Strategy: maximize EPC, not O&M.
- **BESS** = new growth engine (EPC + manufacturing + IPP).
- **Module mfg** = backward-integration / captive (in-house module consumed in own EPC → eliminated on consol, adds margin not top line).
business.title: Segment (EPC vs O&M vs new verticals)

business.body:
- DCR/ALCM2 cell shortage → benefits **backward-integrated EPCs (SOLARWORLD ⭐, domestic cell/module makers)** vs unintegrated EPCs.
- BESS demand 30 GW → ~250 GW by FY32 → benefits **BESS EPC + container/cell manufacturers** ✅ (SOLARWORLD positioned).
- PPA-signing / connectivity bottleneck resolution (substation push) → unlocks deferred solar EPC pipeline (~FY27-end).

---
business.title: Challenges → Beneficiaries

latest_quarter.body:
- FY26 EBITDA margin 13.3%; PAT margin 8.5%. Q4 EBITDA 12.1%, PAT 8.1%.
- Headwinds: copper +40%, aluminium +50% (vs Oct-25), steel up; INR 85/86→96 (BESS RM largely imported). War (West Asia) is the swing factor.
- Tailwinds: backward integration (captive modules → margin accretion on consol), cell line to cut RM cost / mitigate ALMM-link volatility; BESS structurally higher-margin.
- DCR cost is **pass-through** to developer on new EPC bids (no DCR in current order book → insulated).
latest_quarter.title: Margins & Cost

latest_quarter.body: - **Q4 FY26 (first note):** FY26 rev Rs 1,416 cr (+~157%), PAT Rs 120.4 cr; Q4 rev Rs 591 cr (+235%). Order book Rs 2,800 cr (Solar Rs 1,674 cr / BESS Rs 1,136 cr). BESS ongoing 582 MW AC / 1.2 GWh DC. Module line (1.5 GW Roorkee) live; BESS mfg (3.4 GW) trials; cell line (1.2 GW Pandhurna) COD Jun-27. FY27 guide ~Rs 2,000 cr (+40–45%), margins 8–11%, BESS rev Rs 800–1,000 cr (from zero). Key wins: NTPC Solapur+Unchahar BESS 514 MWh ~Rs 500 cr; NTPC REL Bikaner 260 MW solar ~Rs 200 cr. SJVN claim Rs 219 cr (Rs 52 cr booked). D/E 0.3x; net worth Rs 844.8 cr.
latest_quarter.title: QoQ Log

outlook.body:
- **FY27 Revenue:** ~**Rs 1,900–2,000 cr** (≈70–75% conversion of Rs 2,800 cr order book). Mgmt also framed it as **~40–45% growth** over FY26.
  - BESS revenue: **Rs 800–1,000 cr** (FY26 BESS revenue was ZERO).
  - Solar EPC revenue: **~Rs 1,250 cr → stays ~flat** (so blended ~Rs 2,000 cr).
- **Margins (blended):** guided range **8%–11%**. EPC margins normally 9–11%; abnormally pressured now by war-driven metal inflation + INR. If war subsides → margins improve; if it persists → slight downside risk.
  - EPC PAT margin currently ~10.5% (mgmt claims among best in industry).
  - **BESS margin: 14–15% PBT** (better than solar).
- **Order inflow FY27:** declined to quantify (PSU reverse-bidding, hard to predict); market described as "good," BESS growing "very fast."
- **Seasonality:** Q1/Q2 weak, Q3/Q4 strong — pattern to persist.
- Missed prior guide: earlier Rs 1,500 cr top line @ 11% PAT not met (landed ~8–8.5% PAT) — attributed to war headwinds + late module ALMM.
outlook.title: Guidance (CRITICAL)

outlook.body:
- **Total order book ~Rs 2,800 cr (Rs 28 bn):** Solar EPC + O&M **Rs 1,674 cr (Rs 16 bn)**; BESS EPC + IPP **Rs 1,136 cr (Rs 11 bn)**.
- **BESS ongoing projects: ~582 MW AC / 1.2 GWh DC.**
- New BESS EPC wins (in quarter): NTPC thermal stations at **Solapur (MH)** & **Unchahar (UP)**, aggregating **~514 MWh**, combined value **~Rs 5 bn (Rs 500 cr)** incl. O&M.
- New solar win: **NTPC REL — 260 MW DC grid-connected solar PV BOS, Bikaner**, ~**Rs 2 bn (Rs 200 cr)** incl. O&M.
- Completed-project capacity ~348 MW; +272 MW & +70 MW projects completing June-26 → ~600 MW; targeting ~700 MW next qtr and **~1.5 GW by FY27-end**.
- 600 MW NTPC REL module-supply order in hand for FY27 (100% serviceable in-house).
outlook.title: Order Book & Pipeline (MW + Rs)

outlook.body:
- **Solar module mfg:** 1.5 GW, Roorkee (7.5 acres, automated ATW & Horad lines, TOPCon 600–750 W; M10R/G12R/G12). Break-even at ~30–35% utilisation (low headcount + low depreciation; capex only ~Rs 146 cr). FY27 utilisation ~40–45% on 600 MW NTPC order, scaling to 60–65% as orders add.
- **Solar cell mfg:** 1.2 GW at **Pandhurna**; under construction, **COD June-2027**; funds (~Rs 430 cr IPO earmark) largely unspent — heavy utilisation expected ~Q3 FY27. ALCM2 upside.
- **BESS manufacturing:** 3.4 GW fully-automated (KUKA Robotics), trials underway; capex ~Rs 55–60 cr already spent. Capacity ~740 containers/yr × ~Rs 4.5 cr = **~Rs 3,000 cr revenue potential** at full capacity, ~14–15% PBT.
- **Junction box:** 5 GW line in JV — ready for trials (backward integration).
- IPP optionality within BESS order book.
outlook.title: Growth / Optionality

deepdive.thesis: Recently-listed solar EPC player pivoting from pure utility-scale solar EPC into an **integrated renewables platform** — adding solar module mfg (1.5 GW live), solar cell mfg (1.2 GW, COD June-2027), and BESS (manufacturing + EPC + IPP). Management explicitly positions itself as **"India's only EPC company backward-integrated into manufacturing."** FY26 was a breakout year (revenue +~157% / ~2.5x to Rs 1,416 cr; PAT Rs 120 cr) and the stated strategic target is a **60:40 BESS-to-solar EPC revenue mix** over time. Near-term margin is hostage to elevated metal/raw-material prices (copper +40%, aluminium +50% vs Oct-25) tied to the West Asia war and INR depreciation (85→96).
